claims.text: An Authorization header whose Bearer prefix uses any letter casing (e.g. 'bearer <token>', 'BEARER <token>', 'BeArEr <token>') authenticates the request the same way as 'Bearer <token>'.
A valid token sent with the canonical 'Bearer ' prefix, or with no prefix at all, still authenticates the request.
An invalid token is still rejected regardless of the casing of the Bearer prefix.
